Tomorrow at noon, every photo you have ever taken goes public.
Not just this year. Every blurry selfie, every screenshot, every photo of your screen at two in the morning, every picture you deleted and thought was gone.
Your entire camera roll becomes the internet.
At first, it's chaos. People find photos from ten years ago and suddenly they know your whole story.
Your boss sees the job search screenshots. Your friends see the party pictures you swore you deleted.
Strangers learn your street, your school, your first car, even your coffee order.
And the scariest part is you can't take it back. You can't delete the internet.
So you start wondering about everyone else. If your life is public, what did they post about you?
